purpose: Classify the physical port cost of every minimum-size direct OR_3 clause atom in the exact Boolean q layer. v8.2 already proved that no source-open OR_3, reverse-OR_3 or NAE_3 matching exists through four cross-wire splice edges and exhibited one five-edge OR_3 witness. Exhaust all source-open five-edge matchings and determine every OR_3 port-load vector. This freezes the true residual-port obligation for any variable-consistency/fanout gadget intended to feed the minimum OR_3 atom.

model.local_state: Exact (c,s,q) boundary normal form from v8.2.
model.source_open_gate: Cross-wire splice edges form a matching on dangling ports and may not close a Hamiltonian component together with the wires' three internal open H paths.

five_edge_exhaustion.check: Counts sum to 27168. Every exact OR_3 witness uses ten port incidences, as required by five splice edges, and the only possible realized distribution is a permutation of 3+3+4.

main_theorem.name: EVERY_MINIMUM_DIRECT_OR3_ATOM_CONSUMES_AT_LEAST_THREE_PORTS_ON_EACH_INPUT
main_theorem.statement: In the direct three-wire matching language, OR_3 has minimum splice size five, and every source-open five-edge OR_3 realization has wire loads equal to a permutation of (3,3,4). In particular no minimum OR_3 atom can attach to a q occurrence with fewer than three available dangling ports.
proof: Use the exact v8.2 (c,s,q) semantics with global colour symmetry fixing one wire frame, so every q triple is tested by a 36-bit exact frame mask.
Enumerate every five-edge matching in increasing edge order while maintaining the exact open-path endpoint pairing; reject exactly those edge sets that close an H cycle.
Project the surviving exact frame masks to the eight q triples and select relation mask OR_3, i.e. every Boolean triple except all-FALSE.
Count the number of used dangling ports on A,B,C. The exhaustive catalog contains 27168 OR_3 gadgets and exactly the three displayed ordered load vectors, 9056 times each.

positive: Turns the single (3,4,3) v8.2 OR witness into a complete minimum-interface theorem.
A named q wire that must later serve as a minimum OR_3 literal occurrence needs at least three residual ports after variable-consistency plumbing.

For a one-hidden-wire fanout search with three named clause-occurrence outputs, the named wires may spend at most three ports each while the hidden wire may spend at most six; therefore at most seven fanout splice edges can exist. This gives the next search a strict finite depth bound.
firewall: The three-residual-port requirement is for direct minimum five-edge OR_3 atoms. Larger clause gadgets might trade more auxiliary wires for a different terminal load profile and are not excluded.
No variable fanout or NP-hardness reduction is claimed here.

next_target.name: E8_ONE_HIDDEN_Q_FANOUT_SEVEN_EDGE_EXACT_SEARCH_V8_4
next_target.directive: Search exactly four twisted wires: three named outputs A,B,C that each retain at least three dangling ports for a minimum OR_3 occurrence, plus one hidden auxiliary D allowed to consume all six ports. Hence named fanout loads are <=3, hidden load <=6, and total fanout size is <=7 edges. Project D existentially and require the named q relation ALL_EQ_3. Preserve exact (c,s,q) frame masks and source-open H-path topology. A negative result must exhaust the complete bounded state space; random near-misses are not evidence.
